"""READ-ONLY adjudication of uptake.py's verdict_before_launch flags.

Replicates rcalib.launch_time but prints the *matched command text* so each flagged
'launch before verdict' can be classified by hand. Writes nothing into the repo.
"""
import sys, json
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/home/robtang_google_com/gangda_workspace/agentic-world-model")
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "tools" / "wma-rca"))
from rcalib import (LAUNCH, batch_cells, bash_command, g, load_cards, load_locks,  # noqa
                    load_verdicts, parse_transcript, ts)


def launch_candidates(card_id, card, locked_at, calls, limit=6):
    family = g(card, "setup.method.family")
    out_dir = str(g(card, "setup.output_dir") or "").rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
    hits = []
    for when, tool, text in calls:
        if tool != "Bash" or when is None or locked_at is None or when < locked_at - timedelta(minutes=3):
            continue
        if LAUNCH.search(text) and (card_id in text or (out_dir and out_dir in text) or family == "other"):
            why = []
            if card_id in text:
                why.append("card_id")
            if out_dir and out_dir in text:
                why.append("out_dir")
            if family == "other":
                why.append("family=other")
            hits.append({"t": when.isoformat(), "why": "+".join(why),
                         "cmd": bash_command(text)[:600]})
            if len(hits) >= limit:
                break
    return {"family": family, "out_dir": out_dir, "hits": hits}


def main(batches):
    out = []
    for batch, cell, cell_dir, _ in batch_cells(batches):
        calls, _res = parse_transcript(cell_dir)
        cards, locks, verdicts = load_cards(cell_dir), load_locks(cell_dir), load_verdicts(cell_dir)
        for card_id, card in sorted(cards.items()):
            lock = locks.get(card_id) or {}
            locked = ts(lock.get("locked_at"))
            v = verdicts.get(card_id)
            issued = ts(v.get("issued_at")) if v and not v.get("_rejected") else None
            info = launch_candidates(card_id, card, locked, calls)
            out.append({"cell": cell, "card": card_id, "locked": locked.isoformat() if locked else None,
                        "issued": issued.isoformat() if issued else None, **info})
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
